purpose: Freight-forwarder marketing website: logistics hero and service lanes, how-it-works timeline, live shipment tracking demo, instant quote builder, case studies and contact, built in plain HTML/CSS/JS with one editable content file.

features.name: Cargolane marketing site: hero, live shipment board, instant quote, proof, contact
features.description: Complete static marketing site for a fictional freight-forwarding platform. Editorial hero with a lane-network panel; feature grid; filterable live shipment board with milestone detail, escalation and tracking-link actions; instant quote builder with distance-based pricing, transit and CO2 estimate; how-it-works; 'no black box' stack section; case studies; integrations; contact form. All copy and seeded data in content.js, no framework or build step.
